subject: Is my data safe in shinyapps

messages.author: 306967f25f699560
messages.subject: Is my data safe in shinyapps
parts:
Dear shiny users,

I made an app in which the user can upload a datafile to use. It is basically a data analytics tool. Now I am hosting it on shinyapps.io where of course it is accessible to all.
My concern is not actually about the app being accessible for everyone, but rather with the data of the user.
Are the users of my app risking their (possibly confidential) data?

I would be glad to hear more about this!

With kind regards,

Pieter

Hi Pieter,
Not sure if you saw this already, but we have a section in the user guide that tries to answer some of the concerns you have raised.  I would appreciate it if you could give it a quick read through and let us know what questions are still unanswered so we can improve it.

Best,
Tareef
